data.source_setting: NHS patient-facing advice for arm and wrist injury/fracture.
data.source_n: Not applicable; patient advice, no patient cohort.
data.quantity: Urgent or immediate care triggers for arm/wrist injury and recovery

urgent_advice_nhs_111_injury: very severe or worsening pain or unable to use due to pain
immediate_a_and_e_or_999_injury: new color change, shape change, or odd angle
urgent_advice_nhs_111_during_recovery: swelling or blue/white fingers, wrist, or arm
bad smell or discharge under cast

data.source_evidence_basis: The NHS page separates urgent NHS 111 advice for injury symptoms from immediate A&E/999 triggers, and provides separate NHS 111 advice for problems during recovery, including cast and neurovascular symptoms.
data.limitations: UK patient advice, not an individualized clinical pathway or exhaustive clinician red-flag list. Routing and urgency must follow local emergency instructions; the source does not estimate return probability.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Authored branch: distinguish urgent advice from immediate emergency triggers and distinguish initial injury advice from recovery/cast problems. Provide locally routed instructions; do not imply every symptom requires the same destination.
